_note: 30-day value-first slate for @nolapartybarge, Oct 17 to Nov 15 2026. Paths are relative to the Documents folder (the vault root's parent). 'cx' is the horizontal crop center (0..1) for landscape masters. 'cover' is burned only onto clips that have no on-screen text yet. No caption contains a URL, phone, price, or 'book now'.

posts.caption: Rules are rules. Tag the friend who's always late.
posts.why: Our all-time best post (33.9k likes, May 2024). Two and a half years later, most followers have never seen it.

posts.caption: The Great Wall of Louisiana. Almost two miles of concrete between the Gulf and the city, and you ride right past it. Send this to somebody who thinks New Orleans is just Bourbon Street.
posts.why: Boosted three times this summer, $0.022 a click, best in the account all year. The fact lane converts.

posts.caption: He's seen things. Tag the designated adult in your group.

posts.caption: Head of marina security. Does not take bribes. Send this to someone who's scared of geese.

posts.caption: 25 years married and she still fires first. Tag your person.
posts.why: Pure joy, real guests, tag-bait.

posts.caption: That second-line sound at the dock. Only here. Send it to someone who needs to come home.

posts.caption: Saturday on the bayou. Tag who's on the boat.
posts.why: Crew-shot, graded 'great'. Golden light, real guests.

posts.caption: October gators. The water's still warm enough that they're eating before the cold, so you see more of them now than in July. Nobody knows this. Save it for your trip.
posts.why: Guests at the rail watching a gator surface, crew-shot Aug 3. Fact + animal in frame. Save-bait. Captain's Report material once Jeff films one.

posts.caption: Made this in 2019. Still boat guy. Tag a boat guy.
posts.why: Captain monologue, burned-in text is the bit. Repost as is.

posts.caption: There's a horse in the marina. Nobody knows why. Send this to someone from Louisiana and watch them not be surprised.
posts.why: Weird lane, share-bait.

posts.caption: Aisle rehearsal, bayou edition. Tag the bride.
posts.why: Bachelorette moment without a bachelorette pitch.

posts.caption: The ghost of Whitney haunts the Freaky Tiki. Tomorrow and Saturday the whole bayou goes pirate. Which song are you haunting us with?
posts.why: Halloween eve-eve. Karaoke clip with 166 likes from 2022, reframed as a haunting.

posts.caption: Halloween eve on the water. Costumes were never optional out here. Tag your crew.
posts.why: Pink-suit crew on the passing boat. Costume energy on the day it matters.

posts.src: NOLA Party Barge/Marketing/Freaky Tiki TikTok/Ready to Post/drone-gator-v2.mp4

posts.caption: Jean Lafitte ran this bayou in 1812. We found his treasure. Sort of. Send this to your history friend.
posts.why: Storytime lane. Repost; remake with a captain telling it once Captain's Report is rolling.

posts.caption: Another world record on the Freaky Tiki. Guinness has not returned our calls. Tag someone who'd try it.
posts.why: Best Capt. Save-a-Hoe skit per the IG sweep. Only 15 likes in February, which means it never got seen.

posts.caption: Marina zoo, episode: the skink. Send this to someone who hates spiders.
posts.why: Weird lane.

posts.caption: Real mic. No notes. Tag your duet partner.
posts.why: Raw master, night karaoke duet with a laugh. From the moment inventory.

posts.caption: Friendsgiving on the water, Nov 20 to 22. Everybody brings a dish, fire pits after. Who's bringing the mac and cheese?
posts.why: Matches the Holiday Pushes plan (goes live Oct 13). Date plus a question, no price.

posts.caption: Golden hour has a soundtrack. Tag the friend who thinks she can sing.
posts.why: Silhouette belting into a champagne bottle at sunset.

posts.caption: The bar is a stage. Tag who'd do the worm.

posts.caption: The swamp doesn't cancel. Send this to the friend who checks the weather nine times.

posts.caption: When two boats pass out here. Tag who'd wave first.
